long_biography.plain_text:
At Columbia Business School, Mazzolini taught international corporate strategy and wrote about cross-border concentration and state-owned enterprises. His scholarship followed a Columbia undergraduate degree and a Stanford doctorate completed in 1973. The same interest in how capital shapes companies later appeared in decades of investment-company appointments across Luxembourg.

In Monaco, he spent about two decades advancing the difficult redevelopment that became Le Luciana. The mixed-use plan required agreements with the municipality, the state and the bus company, alongside his commitment to finance and deliver the new building. Completed in 2024, the project combined private residences with commercial premises transferred to public owners.
